item.description: The _map_function_annotations function has incomplete parameter mapping logic that fails to properly handle Pydantic validation and missing parameters, causing "missing_argument" errors when parameters are not found in template inputs.
item.contract: Update the parameter mapping logic in _map_function_annotations to properly handle missing parameters by either using defaults or raising appropriate exceptions. Ensure that when a parameter is annotated with a Pydantic type, it gets validated properly during parameter loading.

item.description: The artifact path resolution logic fails with "unsupported operand type(s) for /: 'PosixPath' and 'NoneType'" errors when artifact paths are not properly initialized or resolved, particularly for input artifacts without explicit paths.
item.contract: Fix the artifact path resolution in _get_artifact_path to properly handle cases where artifact paths are None or not provided, ensuring that all paths are properly constructed and never None before path operations.

item.description: The type validation logic in _save_annotated_return_outputs incorrectly compares types, particularly for generic types like typing.Dict[str, str] vs dict, causing "type does not match annotated type" errors.
item.contract: Improve the type validation logic in _save_annotated_return_outputs to properly handle generic types and provide more flexible type checking that accepts compatible concrete types (e.g., dict for typing.Dict, list for typing.List).

item.description: The _runner function fails to properly handle functions with missing 'to_dict' attribute when processing script annotations, particularly for artifact loading scenarios.
item.contract: Ensure that when processing script annotations, the code properly handles cases where functions or objects don't have a 'to_dict' method by implementing graceful fallback behavior.

item.description: The _write_to_path function has issues with None paths and improper handling of bytes data that causes failures in artifact and parameter dumping operations.
item.contract: Improve _write_to_path to properly handle None paths and ensure bytes data is correctly written to disk without errors.
